list.title: Approvals
list.description: Requests that take effect only after an administrator approves them. Approving acts on the requester's behalf, so it also requires the permission for that operation.

review.title: Review
review.rolesPlaceholder: None (can be changed later on the user page)
review.commentPlaceholder: Review comment (optional, recorded in the audit log)
review.missingCreatePermission: Approving a registration creates an account and requires the "Create user" permission. You can still reject it.

quickApprove.title: Approve registration
quickApprove.confirm: Approve the request from "{{name}}"? An active account will be created without roles (assign them later on the user page, or open the review dialog instead).

approve.title: Approve requests
approve.confirm: Approve {{count}} requests? Active accounts will be created without roles or a review comment (open the review dialog to assign roles).
approve.ineligible: Only pending requests can be approved; approving a registration requires the "Create user" permission.

reject.title: Reject requests
reject.confirm: Reject {{count}} requests? No review comment will be attached.
reject.ineligible: Only pending requests can be rejected.
